release_notes: Build 107 adds a Fix SEO action to the dedicated Website SEO audit for warning rows that can be corrected safely.
Fix SEO generates a proposed search/social metadata correction, simulates it against the full website quiz inventory, and only enables when the result passes the SEO audit.
Before anything is saved, a review window shows the exact current and proposed values for every field that would change.
Applying a fix uses the existing authenticated website SEO API, reruns the full catalogue audit, and automatically selects the next remaining finding.
Duplicate search titles are made unique without changing the published quiz slug, URL, questions or category.
Duplicate visible quiz titles are treated as an SEO warning while they also create duplicate search titles; a unique SEO title can therefore clear the search ambiguity without renaming the quiz.
Short or overlong meta descriptions and overlong search/social titles or descriptions can be repaired from the existing Factburst SEO defaults.
Structural findings such as invalid or duplicate slugs remain manual and cannot be auto-applied.
Build 106 Quiz History cleanup and Build 105 SEO warning explanations remain included unchanged.
